name: health-evidence-companion
description: Evidence-based medical and adult psychological education with separate private-record workflows.

interface.longDescription: Medical and adult psychological education with separate owner-authorized private-record workflows. Nineteen skills add lay first aid, nutrition review, verified care navigation and focused history to the existing medical and psychological routes. The clinical navigation library connects anatomy, common symptoms, medicine/therapy classes, chronic conditions, tests, life stages, endometriosis, neuroscience and ageing to current source searches. Source records preserve actual reading depth, jurisdiction and uncertainty. Standard treatment options prepare clinician questions; no individualized prescription, remote diagnosis or clinical clearance is provided. First-aid cards prioritize immediate lay actions and local dispatch. Existing records and psychological journals remain separate. The package has no publisher backend, patient telemetry, automatic account access or validated clinical engine. New therapeutic approvals, trial evidence and remaining gaps are distinguished. Host capabilities and chosen storage controls apply.
capabilities: Discuss optional CBT, ACT and MCT practices
defaultPrompt: Help me understand this health concern and prepare clinician questions.

publication.release_notes: Version 0.7.0 expands source-linked clinical navigation, medicine and therapy classes, nutrition, lay first aid, chronic conditions, diagnostics, life-stage anatomy, endometriosis, neuropsychiatry, ageing and care-service search. Added skills and synthetic evaluations do not constitute clinical validation.
